comment: The Thousand Maws of Toto-Rak's second room boss's two adds (BNpcBase 271, both layout 3656529): 467 HP, level 24, called as the boss falls to 50 %; auto-attack 872, 1014 every 6.9 s. For 364, 345 and 1014, which only poison, the recorded amount is the poison's tick (retail's ActionEffect gives it with the status). From Bob's Chronofoil captures of the Thousand Maws of Toto-Rak (2026-10-30): one run with Duty Support (caa5e908, visit 0.15) and two Duty Finder runs (1fac2416 and 2528a32d, visits 0.15 and 0.14), `questkit chronofoil --battle`. `players` is the median damage to players over the three runs, `npcs` to the Duty Support members; `every` the median time between uses. Hitbox not recorded.
